                  <p className="eyebrow">In this order</p>
                  <h2 className="mt-1.5 font-display text-xl text-forest">
                    {itemCount} {itemCount === 1 ? 'plant' : 'plants'}, packed by hand
                  </h2>
                </div>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-ink-faint">
                  <Package size={13} className="text-sage" /> {order.items.length}{' '}
                  {order.items.length === 1 ? 'line' : 'lines'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <ul className="mt-5 divide-y divide-sand/60">
                {order.items.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-3.5 py-4 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                    <div className="relative shrink-0">
                      <ImageWithFallback
                        src={item.image}
                        alt={item.name}
                        className="arch-soft h-16 w-14 object-cover ring-1 ring-sand/70"
                      />
                      <span className="absolute -right-1.5 -top-1.5 grid h-5 min-w-5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-ink px-1 text-[0.65rem] font-medium text-white">
                        {item.qty}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm text-ink">{item.name}</p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-ink-faint">
                        {[item.size, item.color].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'One size'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="shrink-0 font-display text-lg text-forest">
                      {money(item.lineTotal)}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </section>

            {/* ----------------------------- delivery ---------------------------- */}
            <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <section className="card-petal rounded-tl-[1.75rem] rounded-br-[1.75rem] rounded-tr-[0.8rem] rounded-bl-[0.8rem] p-5 md:p-6">
                <p className="eyebrow">Delivery details</p>
                <h2 className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl text-forest">
                  <MapPin size={17} className="text-sage" /> Going to
                </h2>
                <div className="mt-4 space-y-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft">
                  <p className="font-medium text-ink">{order.customer.name}</p>
                  <p>{order.shippingAddress.address}</p>
                  <p>
                    {order.shippingAddress.city}
                    {order.shippingAddress.state ? `, ${order.shippingAddress.state}` : ''}{' '}
                    {order.shippingAddress.zip}
                  </p>
                  <p>{country}</p>
                  <div className="space-y-1 pt-2 text-xs text-ink-faint">
                    <p>{order.customer.email}</p>
                    {order.customer.phone && <p>{order.customer.phone}</p>}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              <section className="card-petal rounded-tl-[1.75rem] rounded-br-[1.75rem] rounded-tr-[0.8rem] rounded-bl-[0.8rem] p-5 md:p-6">
                <p className="eyebrow">Good to know</p>
                <h2 className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl text-forest">
                  <Truck size={17} className="text-sage" /> Getting it home
                </h2>

                <div className="mt-4 rounded-[1.1rem] bg-parchment/70 p-3.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft">
                  <span className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-faint">
                    Studio notes
                  </span>
                  {order.notes || 'No notes — we’ll leave your plants with a neighbour if you’re out.'}
                </div>

                {order.trackingNumber && (
                  <div className="mt-3 rounded-[1.1rem] border border-sand bg-white p-3.5 text-sm">
                    <span className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-faint">
                      Tracking number
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-ink">{order.trackingNumber}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <p className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-ink-faint">
                  <Sprout size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-sage" />
                  Every plant travels in a breathable sleeve. Free replacement if it arrives damaged.
                </p>
              </section>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ------------------------------ receipt ----------------------------- */}
          <aside className="lg:sticky lg:top-28 lg:self-start">
            <div className="card-petal overflow-hidden rounded-tl-[1.75rem] rounded-br-[1.75rem] rounded-tr-[0.8rem] rounded-bl-[0.8rem]">
              <div className="relative isolate overflow-hidden border-b border-sand/60 bg-parchment/60 px-5 py-4">
                <div aria-hidden="true" className="bg-fern pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-25" />
                <div className="relative">
                  <p className="eyebrow">Receipt</p>
                  <h2 className="mt-1 font-display text-xl text-forest">Order total</h2>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5">
                <dl className="space-y-2.5 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-ink-soft">
                    <dt>Subtotal</dt>
                    <dd className="text-ink">{money(order.subtotal)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  {order.discount > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-rose">
                      <dt>Discount {order.couponCode ? `(${order.couponCode})` : ''}</dt>
                      <dd>−{money(order.discount)}</dd>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-ink-soft">
                    <dt>Delivery</dt>
                    <dd className="text-ink">
                      {order.shipping === 0 ? 'Free' : money(order.shipping)}
                    </dd>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-ink-soft">
                    <dt>VAT (16%)</dt>
                    <dd className="text-ink">{money(order.tax)}</dd>
                  </div>
                </dl>

                <div className="mt-4 flex items-baseline justify-between border-t border-sand/70 pt-4">
                  <span className="font-medium text-ink">Total</span>
                  <span className="font-display text-3xl text-forest">{money(order.total)}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-sand/70 pt-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-ink-soft">
                      <PaymentIcon size={14} className="text-sage" /> {payment.label}
                    </span>
                    <StatusBadge status={order.paymentStatus} kind="payment" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-ink-faint">
                    <span>Placed</span>
                    <span className="text-ink-soft">{formatDate(order.createdAt)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 space-y-2.5">
                  <Link to="/account" className="btn btn-primary w-full">
                    View all orders
                  </Link>
                  <Link to="/shop" className="btn btn-secondary w-full">
                    Keep shopping
                  </Link>
                </div>

                <p className="mt-3.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-center text-xs text-ink-faint">
                  <Check size={12} className="text-sage" /> Free replacement if the plant doesn't thrive
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </aside>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const token = fs.readFileSync('/tmp/customer-token.txt', 'utf8').trim();
const [width, height, path, tab, outPath] = process.argv.slice(2);

const t = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/new?http://localhost:5173/', { method: 'PUT' }).then((r) => r.json());
const ws = new WebSocket(t.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
let id = 0;
const pending = new Map();
ws.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
  const m = JSON.parse(e.data);
  if (m.id && pending.has(m.id)) { pending.get(m.id)(m); pending.delete(m.id); }
});
const send = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const n = ++id; pending.set(n, resolve); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: n, method, params }));
});
await new Promise((r) => ws.addEventListener('open', r));
await send('Page.enable');
await send('Runtime.enable');
await send('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: Number(width), height: Number(height), deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: false });
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));
await send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: `localStorage.setItem('hinga.token', ${JSON.stringify(token)})` });
await send('Page.navigate', { url: `http://localhost:5173${path}` });
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4500));
if (tab) {
  await send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim().startsWith(${JSON.stringify(tab)}))?.click()` });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));
}
const info = await send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: `JSON.stringify({h: document.body.scrollHeight, w: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, h1: document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent})`, returnByValue: true });
console.log(info.result?.result?.value);
const shot = await send('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png', captureBeyondViewport: true });
fs.writeFileSync(outPath, Buffer.from(shot.result.data, 'base64'));
ws.close();

**What changed in [OrderConfirmation.jsx](web/src/pages/OrderConfirmation.jsx)**

- Parchment banner with the fern texture, blossom ornament, “Order placed” eyebrow and a personal “Thank you, *Wanjiru*” headline, with the copyable order number as a pill alongside.
- Two-column receipt layout: a numbered delivery timeline with filled forest markers and a highlighted current step, arched item thumbnails with quantity chips, and a sticky receipt card showing the subtotal, BLOOM10 discount, delivery, VAT and an oversized serif total, plus payment method and its Paid/Unpaid badge.
- Delivery details and “Good to know” cards use petal corners and parchment panels for studio notes and tracking, with a plant-care reassurance line.
- The cancelled state now gets its own banner and “What happens now” card instead of a cheery thank-you, and the missing-order state is a botanical panel with links back to account and shop.
- Secondary buttons “View all orders” and “Keep shopping” sit inside the receipt so the page ends with a clear next step.

- Reseeded the demo database afterwards so the preview starts from clean data, and restarted the dev server (it is running and registered in the Preview tab at the storefront home; the confirmation page is at `/order/<order number>` once signed in).

The landscaping page is live at `/landscaping`, with a working quotation request that lands in a new admin queue.

**The page — [Landscaping.jsx](web/src/pages/Landscaping.jsx)**

- Botanical hero: “We plant whole gardens, not just pots”, an arched rose-garden image, the studio’s location note and a “Request a quotation” button, in the same parchment/forest language as the rest of the storefront.
- “Outdoor rooms, planted properly” — three site types (bare-ground gardens, courtyards/terraces/rooftops, offices/hotels/schools) each with what’s included.
- A “Four unhurried steps” band on forest green: share the site → site visit → written quotation → planting and aftercare.
- The quotation form, which asks exactly what you specified plus a little scheduling detail:
  - **Land size** — free text like `320 m²` or `1.2 acres`.
  - **Site location** — estate, town or county.
  - **Preferred flowers** — clickable chips (roses, hydrangeas, bougainvillea, jasmine, lavender, bird of paradise, orchids, kalanchoe, alyssum, indigenous shrubs) plus a free-text field for anything else.
  - **Type of ground**, **timeline** (ASAP → just planning) and an optional **budget guide**.
  - Name, email and phone, which auto-fill for signed-in customers.
- Submitting replaces the form with a “Request received” card showing the reference (`LS-…`), the brief as sent, and what happens next.

**Backend** — new `landscaping_requests` table in [db.js](server/src/db.js), routes in [landscaping.js](server/src/routes/landscaping.js): public POST with validation, and admin-only list / status update / delete behind `requireAdmin`. Wired into [index.js](server/src/index.js) at `/api/landscaping`.

**Admin** — “Landscaping” sits in the [admin sidebar](web/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.jsx) and opens [AdminLandscaping.jsx](web/src/pages/admin/AdminLandscaping.jsx): status filter tabs with counts, each request as a card with site, land size, flowers, budget and notes, a stage selector (new → contacted → quoted → won/lost) and delete.

**Navigation** — [Navbar](web/src/components/Navbar.jsx) has a Landscaping link, and the [Footer](web/src/components/Footer.jsx) links both to the page and straight to the form (`/landscaping#quote`, which scrolls to it).

I also seeded three realistic requests in [seed.js](server/src/seed.js) (Lavington courtyard, Karen garden, Kisumu rooftop) so the admin queue isn’t empty.

- Rendered at 1440 px and 390 px with no horizontal overflow on either the page or the admin view.
- Reseeded afterwards; the dev server is running and the Preview tab is showing `/landscaping`.

Added a **Gardens** tab to the account page so customers can follow their own landscaping quotation requests.

**What a customer sees** — [Account.jsx](web/src/pages/Account.jsx)

- A new **Gardens** tab sits between Orders and Profile, with a "New request" button linking back to the quotation form.
- Each request is a card in the same parchment/petal style as the rest of the account: reference (`LS-SEED01`), site type and location as the title, when it was sent and the requested timeline, and a status badge (New, Contacted, Quoted, Won, Lost).
- Under it: land size and budget guide, the flower chips they picked, their site notes, and a plain-language line for the current stage — e.g. "A landscaper is in touch to arrange the site visit and measurements", "Your written quotation is with you — reply to confirm and we book the planting".
- Customers with no requests get an empty state inviting them to request a quotation instead of a blank panel.

**Backend** — `GET /api/landscaping/mine` in [landscaping.js](server/src/routes/landscaping.js), signed-in customers only, scoped to `user_id` so nobody can see another account's requests. Added as `myLandscapingRequests` in [api.js](web/src/lib/api.js), with the stage wording in [landscaping.js](web/src/lib/landscaping.js).

**Verified**

{"kind":"tool","id":"gYTj26q3r3U","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"web/src/context/ThemeContext.jsx","instructions":"Create the theme context with persistence and system preference.","content":"import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'hinga.theme';
const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

const prefersDark = () =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;

function initialTheme() {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  if (stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark') return stored;
  return prefersDark() ? 'dark' : 'light';
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(initialTheme);

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark');
    root.style.colorScheme = theme;
  }, [theme]);

  /* Follow the OS while the visitor has not picked a side. */
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const onChange = (event) => {
      if (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) return;
      setTheme(event.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
    };
    query.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => query.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    setTheme((current) => {
      const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ theme, isDark: theme === 'dark', setTheme, toggle }),
    [theme, toggle],
  );

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside a ThemeProvider');
  return context;
}

The storefront and admin panel now have a dark theme, toggled from a sun/moon button in the header.

**The switch**

- [ThemeToggle.jsx](web/src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx) sits in the storefront nav icon row (visible on mobile too) and in the admin header beside "Storefront".
- [ThemeContext.jsx](web/src/context/ThemeContext.jsx) holds the choice, writes it to `localStorage` as `hinga.theme`, and follows the OS setting until the visitor picks a side — after that their choice wins.
- A small inline script in [index.html](web/index.html) applies the class before React mounts, so there's no white flash on reload.

**The palette — [index.css](web/src/index.css)**

- Added `--color-canvas` (page) and `--color-surface` (cards/fields) so page and paper can darken independently of `cream`, which stays light because it's the ink on the deep-green bands.
- `.dark` re-points the whole palette: canvas `#100e0b`, surfaces `#1a1713`, warm sand borders, pale ink, brighter leaf/rose/clay/gold so chips and badges stay legible, forest kept deep for the bands and buttons.
- Unlayered overrides catch what the tokens can't: literal `bg-white`/`bg-cream` panels and their alpha variants, `.card`/`.card-petal`, fields, primary/secondary/light buttons, `text-forest` headings and the 39 `hover:text-forest` states, links and the italic `.accent`.
- The hero and CTA wash were photo scrims built from `cream`; those gradient stops now use the page tone, so the hero reads as a dark, moody photo with cream type instead of a washed-out cream panel.
- Grain opacity drops from 0.32 to 0.14, selection and the fern line art are tuned for the dark page.

**Verified**

- `npm run build` passes.
- Toggle: starts light on a system set to light, clicking flips to dark (`html.dark`, body `rgb(16, 14, 11)`, `localStorage: dark`), survives a reload, and clicking again returns to light.
- Screenshotted in dark at 1440 px: home, shop, product, cart, checkout, account, landscaping, login, admin dashboard and admin landscaping — all show dark surfaces with legible cream type, green buttons and readable badges; no layout breakage.
- At 390 px the dark home has zero horizontal overflow and the toggle is reachable in the top row.
- No console or network errors on any page checked; reseeded the demo data afterwards and the preview is showing the home page with the server running.

One deliberate limit: product and hero photography isn't recoloured — in dark mode photos stay as shot, with the hero scrimmed by the page tone.

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
+
+const STORAGE_KEY = 'hinga.theme';
+const ThemeContext = createContext(null);
+
+const prefersDark = () =>
+  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
+
+function initialTheme() {
+  const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
+  if (stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark') return stored;
+  return prefersDark() ? 'dark' : 'light';
+}
+
+export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
+  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(initialTheme);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const root = document.documentElement;
+    root.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark');
+    root.style.colorScheme = theme;
+  }, [theme]);
+
+  /* Follow the OS while the visitor has not picked a side. */
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const query = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
+    const onChange = (event) => {
+      if (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) return;
+      setTheme(event.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
+    };
+    query.addEventListener('change', onChange);
+    return () => query.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
+  }, []);
+
+  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
+    setTheme((current) => {
+      const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
+      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
+      return next;
+    });
+  }, []);
+
+  const value = useMemo(
+    () => ({ theme, isDark: theme === 'dark', setTheme, toggle }),
+    [theme, toggle],
+  );
+
+  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
+}
+
+export function useTheme() {
+  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
+  if (!context) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside a ThemeProvider');
+  return context;
+}

## What's deployed where

[vercel.json](vercel.json) declares two services in one project:

| Service | Root | Framework | Public at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server` | `server/` | `express` | `/api/*` |
| `web` | `web/` | `vite` | everything else |

Rewrites are ordered specific → catch-all, and only the object form is used, so both services are reachable only through these rules.

Two things differ from your starting snippet, both on documented behaviour:

- **The `web` service carries its own SPA fallback** — `{"source":"/(.*)","destination":"/index.html"}`. A top-level rewrite only gets the request *into* a service, and Vercel does not infer SPA routing for Vite, so without this `/shop/monstera-deliciosa` would 404 on reload. It's a `rewrite`, so real files in `dist/assets` still win (rewrites run after the filesystem check).
- **No `entrypoint` on `server`.** `src/index.js` matches Vercel's accepted Express entry locations and starts with `app.listen`, so detection handles it; pinning a path is only for unusual layouts and is the documented escape hatch if detection misses.

## Code reconciled with the routing

- **No path change needed on either side.** Rewrites forward the original path (`GET /api/users` arrives as `/api/users`), and the Express app already mounts `/api/auth`, `/api/products`, etc. The client already calls the relative `/api` base in [api.js](web/src/lib/api.js#L1), so the browser hits the same origin as the page. Nothing hardcodes `localhost:4000` outside the Vite dev proxy.
- **One real blocker fixed — the database location.** Vercel functions run from a read-only directory, so `mkdirSync(DATA_DIR)` would have thrown `EROFS` on the first request and the API would never have booted. [db.js](server/src/db.js#L9-L27) now uses `/tmp/hinga.db` when it detects a serverless host and keeps `server/data/hinga.db` locally; a `DB_PATH` env var still wins over both.

## Bindings: none added

There are no service-to-service calls in this repo — I checked for `fetch`, `axios`, and any absolute API base, and there are none. The only cross-service traffic is the **browser** calling `/api`, which is plain same-origin HTTP through the top-level rewrite. A binding is runtime-only and injected into functions, so the static Vite bundle could never read one, and the Express app calls nothing. Adding `SERVER_URL` to `web` would inject a variable no code reads. So the snippet's implied web→server call isn't real — flag it if you know of a planned one.
